claim_tested: GCaMP (AML32) recordings carry more headroom-normalized held-out lag information than activity-independent GFP (AML18) recordings under the identical docs/7_AGI/25 gate pipeline
claim_not_identified: biological mechanism, anatomical graph, CloudCell, monad, consciousness, or AGI architecture; a PASS would only mean excess lag information relative to the GFP noise model

statistic.per_target: delta_prime_i = (r2_local_memory - r2_current_nonlinear) / (1 - r2_current_nonlinear), evaluated on the held-out test block exactly as produced by evaluate_local_memory_recording
statistic.target_exclusion_guard: exclude targets with (1 - r2_current_nonlinear) < 0.01 (denominator instability guard, fixed in design note Section 3 before this run)
statistic.per_recording: D_r = median over included targets of delta_prime_i (median-of-ratios; the pre-exploration in the design note Section 5 used ratio-of-medians and is explicitly NOT the scoring statistic)

test.procedure: exact one-sided Mann-Whitney U on recording-level values D_r, full enumeration of C(18,7) assignments, ties counted 0.5
test.secondary: horizon_steps = 1 (reported; does not override the primary verdict)
test.deferred_confirmations_if_pass: eta covariate adjustment (design note L1) and whitened-GFP replication (design note (b)) are required before any PASS is promoted; they are not run if the primary test does not reach p <= 0.05

decision_rule.KILL: primary (h=6) p > 0.05 AND (median_AML32 - median_AML18) <= 0.02. Consequence: the 'neural temporal memory' interpretation of docs/7_AGI/25 is dead for both horizons; the gate claim is demoted to 'non-Markovianity of the measurement process'; every CE-AGI biological-alignment claim citing this gate is demoted with it.
decision_rule.PASS: primary p <= 0.05 (GCaMP significantly exceeds GFP); promotion further requires sign stability under eta adjustment and whitened-GFP replication per design note Section 3
decision_rule.INCONCLUSIVE: primary p > 0.05 AND median difference > 0.02 (power-limited; no interpretation promoted)
decision_rule.power_note: the 0.02 tolerance means effects up to ~2 percentage points of residual variance can be missed; this is stated in advance and will not be adjusted after seeing results

model.settings: identical to docs/7_AGI/25 confirmatory runs: chronological 60/20/20 split, embargo 5, ridge grid [0.01, 0.1, 1.0, 10.0, 100.0], validation-only selection, max_gap_factor 2.0, min 20 samples per split
model.null_shifts: circular-shift nulls are NOT part of this test (the strain contrast itself is the null); the evaluation is run with n_null_shifts=1 solely because the implementation requires >= 1, and null outputs are discarded. The fitted current/local models and their test R^2 are unaffected by the null count.
